chunks: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'The man places the mug which he uses to scoop from the container in a dirty place, then puts it back into the container.'
He said: 'He should pour out three handfuls of water, then rub the mug.'

key_terms.أَكُفٌّ: Plural of كَفّ (palm/handful); used as a unit of measure here
key_terms.الْحُبُّ: A large water jar or container (earthenware), used to store water
key_terms.الْكُوزُ: A small clay jug or pitcher used to scoop water from a larger vessel
key_terms.مَكَانٌ قَذِرٌ: A dirty or ritually impure place
key_terms.يَدْلُكُ: To rub or scrub; indicates physical cleaning action beyond mere rinsing

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling for purifying a vessel that was placed in an impure place then put back into a water container?
ai.summary: Bakkar ibn Abi Bakr asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the ruling for a scooping vessel that had been placed in an impure location and then returned to the water container. The Imam prescribed a specific purification procedure: pouring out three handfuls of water from the vessel and then rubbing (scrubbing) it. This ruling addresses the transfer of ritual impurity (najasah) to vessels used in water storage, reflecting the Shia fiqh concern with maintaining the purity of water supplies used for ritual purposes.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl, from the one who mentioned it, from Yunus, from Bakkar Bin Abu Bakr who said, 
‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The man places the mug which he scoops with from the container, in a dirty place, then he enters it into the container’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should pour out three hand-scoops of the water then rub the mug’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl from those whom he has mentioned from Yunus from Bakkar ibn abu Bakr who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a mug with which one takes water from a large water container but one places it on a dirty place, then immerses it in the large water container.
He (the Imam) said, ‘He must pour water on the mug three times and rub it.’”
